name: CALIGULA: 1996
detailed_description:
WARNING: This game is not recommended for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other medical conditions worsened by abrasive visual elements. 

You are Adam Moore, a cutthroat former Massachusetts State Police officer now FBI agent. An elusive serial killer that refers to himself as "Caligula" torments your hometown of Great Barrington. Leaving zero evidence in crime scenes besides cryptic symbols and hallucinogenic plants, the Bureau has little evidence to lead to the capture of Caligula.

Follow Agent Moore through a visual novel/FPS horror hybrid to uncover the truth surrounding New England's most prolific murderer.

CALIGULA: 1996 INCLUDES:

  • Complex dialogue trees and multiple endings.

  • A wide variety of equipment, consumables, and weapons. Experimenting is essential to success.

  • Secrets - lots of them...

  • Horrors beyond human comprehension.

  • Substance abuse. An enormous level of substance abuse.

  • Death, dying, failure, misery, suffering, agony, malaise: You are going to die! Often!

Will you be able to take Caligula down? Or will you be another one of his victims...

Drug use, abuse, and forced non-consensual drug use is frequent. Extreme profanity is incredibly frequent. Sexual themes including sexual violence are present but infrequent. Sexual themes and imagery including BDSM equipment are very frequent. Themes of self-harm, suicide, and mental illness are frequent. Themes of abortion, miscarriage, and violence against children are infrequent. CALIGULA: 1996 is a profoundly painful experience.
